node.title: L1 fixed-source anchored triple-polarity closure
node.statement: Fix one maximal source and consider genuine degree-ell common-pencil recharts whose quotient partition carries one whole fixed-source petal. For every partition, include points outside its complete ell-fibers in the layout and defect polarities. Under fixed caps R_0,B_0,P_0, arbitrary partial source cores, complete-fiber source petals, every degree strip, ell>=c_0 n/log_2 n, ell>2P_0, and q<=n^gamma, the total across all anchored partitions and canonical charts is at most M_src(R_0+1)(B_0+1)(P_0+1)16^(n/ell)n^(R_0+B_0+P_0)q^(2P_0), hence polynomial. The strict-window and thin-edge CRT bounds pay all numerator/Forney multiplicity in this scope. Growing triple polarity, unanchored or smaller-fiber quotient maps, and arbitrary petal locators remain open.
